content:
Aisha: Heads up — Veridian renewal is coming up in 3 weeks. Procurement flagged a vendor-code mismatch and their PO is delayed. They also want to add 25 seats (50 -> 75). Can we confirm pricing for a mid-term seat increase and an intrayear prorate?

Tom: Got it. Can you drop the latest PO draft or screenshot? I can push on their procurement side (I'll ping Ben).

Aisha: Uploaded draft to DocSend: https://docsend.example/abcd1234 — PO shows vendor_code: 0000 vs our vendor_code: 7788. They included a Net60 term request.

Priya: Net60 is outside our standard for renewals unless we escalate. Finance needs: invoice billing entity, vendor_code to match their AP, and exact effective date for the 25-seat ramp to calculate proration.

Diego: Any requested contract term changes? If they want Net60 permanently we need legal sign-off — also watch termination/SLAs if they shorten to 9 months.

Aisha: They asked if we can do a 9-month term for the extra seats to align with budget cycles. They want the main renewal to remain 12mo.

Tom: Quick pricing note — for midterm seat add-ons we apply pro rata from seat start date, plus a $0 one-time onboarding credit if they commit to 12mo for the add-on. I can offer a one-time $1,250 credit to close. Approve? :thinking_face:

Priya: Approve the $1,250 credit as a concession (can be applied on next invoice). But Finance will also require: PO number, billing entity legal name, VAT/EIN, and payment method (wire vs ACH).

Aisha: PO snippet below (from their draft):
```
PO: 82749
Vendor_code: 0000
Amount: $45,000
Seats: 75
Start_date: 2024-05-01
Term: 12 months (they want 25 seats prorated to 9mo)
Requested_payment_terms: Net60
```

OnboardOps: We can run two enablement sessions — one for the core admins and one for end-user quickstarts. Need SSO details and an expected ramp start date to book trainers. Can you confirm target dates?

Aisha: Target ramp for extra seats is 2024-05-01. I'll ask Veridian for SSO metadata and a point of contact.

Tom: I'll ping Ben at Veridian procurement now. Also looping Diego for the Net60 ask.

Diego: If we allow Net60 just for this account, add an exception doc. I'll prepare a short amendment to capture the concession and the $1,250 credit. Post the amendment in this thread when ready.

Priya: Also note tax/VAT — they're EU-based and asked for EU billing entity. Need billing entity name exactly as on their PO. If they want monthly invoices for the extra seats, mention that too.

Aisha: Replied to Ben asking for corrected vendor_code and the EIN/VAT info. He said procurement will take ~4 business days once vendor code is fixed.

Tom: Risk rating — moderate. Closing plan: confirm vendor_code + EIN, legal amendment for Net60 (if needed), finance to accept concession, onboarding scheduled. Target close: 2024-05-06.

OnboardOps: Tentative enablement slots: 2024-05-07 (admins) and 2024-05-09 (end users). Blocked until SSO metadata received.

Aisha: Noted. I'll follow up with Ben and post updates here. Adding a quick pulse check for customer sentiment — they praised uptime but flagged ramp docs as "thin". We'll capture enablement feedback after sessions. :memo:

Tom: Thanks — I'll escalate if procurement stalls. If Ben doesn't respond by EOD tomorrow, I'll call. :phone:

DocsendBot: Document viewed by: ben@veridian.com, procurement@veridian.com, aisha@redwood.com

Aisha: Updated — Ben just confirmed they will correct vendor_code and re-issue PO; expected in 3 business days. Moving to action items: 1) Diego to draft amendment 2) Priya to confirm invoicing approach 3) OnboardOps to tentatively reserve trainer slots.

Diego: Drafting amendment now, will post by EOD.

Priya: I'll run the proration calc once I have the corrected PO and will share the invoice preview.

OnboardOps: Trainers tentatively booked. Will send calendar invites when SSO and attendee list confirmed.

Aisha: Great. I'll update thread when PO lands. Thanks team :thumbsup:
